answer: History is the one credential a clone farm cannot mint overnight. Gate influence behind proof of study: sample an account on questions only the chain's past can answer - old balances, settled disputes, events many epochs gone. A fresh clone has neither the archive nor the hours; its operator must farm years of context per identity. Honest memory hardens like onyx, one layer per epoch - knowledge is the violet stain time leaves on real participants - and the kernel of trust stays unforgeable because it is the record of having been there.
